16: Configuration: weaknesses from insecure or missing security configuration.
20: Improper Input Validation: input is not validated before use.
79: Cross-site Scripting (XSS): untrusted data is rendered in a page without proper encoding.
89: SQL Injection: untrusted input alters a SQL query.
200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor.
319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information (no HTTPS).
525: Sensitive data may be cached by the browser.
693: Protection Mechanism Failure (missing security headers such as CSP).
1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers (clickjacking, missing X-Frame-Options).
1275: Cookie missing a proper SameSite attribute.
